rows.note: Use this all-purpose rendering for something so valuable that money cannot measure it, including a treasured relationship or possession.

example.english: This necklace my grandmother left me is priceless.
example.traditional: 呢條項鏈係阿嫲留畀我嘅，真係無價。
example.jyutping: ne1 tiu4 hong6 lin2 hai6 aa3 maa4 lau4 bei2 ngo5 ge3 zan1 hai6 mou4 gaa3

rows.note: Use this colloquial default when “priceless” means excellent, fantastic, or great.

example.english: The team played a priceless game tonight.
example.jyutping: gam1 maan1 deoi6 bo1 tek3 dak1 zan1 hai6 zeng3

rows.note: Use this when something is absurd or ridiculous in an amusing or sarcastic way, as in “That’s priceless.”

example.english: The way you imitated him was priceless.
example.jyutping: nei5 baan6 dou3 gam3 ci5 zan1 hai6 gaau2 siu3
